# Sysmon samples

The following Phase 0A XML samples need to be copied in from the lab host before Phase 1 begins:

- `sample_event_1_processcreate.xml`
- `sample_event_3_networkconnect.xml`
- `sample_event_7_imageload.xml`
- `sample_event_10_openprocess.xml`

These files are not available directly in this workspace, so this folder is a staging place only.
